on_exposure_notification.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to run when an exposure notification bluetooth message is received. A variable `x` of type <APIStruct text="exposure_notifications::ExposureNotification" path="exposure_notifications::ExposureNotification" /> is passed to the automation.

*See also: [Exposure Notification Listener](https://esphome.io/components/exposure_notifications#configuration-variables)*
